# The Healthy Malteser

> Healthy, plant-based versions of traditional Maltese food and sweets, created by Geraldine Bartolo. Recipes include ingredients, instructions, and nutritional information where available.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://thehealthymalteser.com/): Introduction and featured recipes.
- [My Story](https://thehealthymalteser.com/mystory/): Geraldine's journey and the story behind the blog.
- [All recipes](https://thehealthymalteser.com/recipes/): Browse the recipe archive.

## Discover all published content
- [Sitemap](https://thehealthymalteser.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical, indexable pages and archives.

Recipes are general food information, not individual medical or nutritional advice. Printable copies duplicate the main recipe pages and are not canonical sources.
